title: vLLM run detail
description: Load, vLLM scheduler state and latency over the course of selected runs.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT experiment FROM runs ORDER BY experiment
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT experiment FROM runs ORDER BY experiment

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run_id AS __value, label AS __text FROM runs WHERE experiment = '$experiment' ORDER BY mode, scenario, rate, rep
list.definition: SELECT run_id AS __value, label AS __text FROM runs WHERE experiment = '$experiment' ORDER BY mode, scenario, rate, rep

options.content: **x-axis of every chart = time.** Sweep runs: **elapsed time since the run's first request** (hh:mm:ss; 00:01:30 = 90 s in; the time picker shows this as 2000-01-01). Replays: the **trace's own UTC time of day**. The first `warmup` seconds of a sweep are not in its summaries. Pick several runs in *Run* to overlay them; drag on a chart to zoom.

panels.title: Offered load: requests arriving per second
panels.description: Requests arriving in each window (Poisson for sweeps, the real trace for replay).

targets.queryText: SELECT time, arrivals_per_s AS value, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, arrivals_per_s AS value, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Completions: requests finishing per second
panels.description: Requests finishing in each window. Falls behind arrivals when vLLM saturates.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, completions_per_s AS value, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, completions_per_s AS value, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT time, running AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, running AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: vLLM queue depth: requests waiting (count)
panels.description: vLLM's num_requests_waiting, sampled every 1 s: requests held in its scheduler. Growing without bound = overloaded.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, waiting AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, waiting AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: KV cache used (% of blocks)
panels.description: Fraction of KV-cache blocks in use. Near 100% vLLM preempts running requests.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, kv_cache_usage AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, kv_cache_usage AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Time to first token: p50 and p99 per time window (log scale)
panels.description: Requests grouped by arrival time into windows (10 s of run time for sweeps).

targets.queryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.ttft_p50_ms AS p50, windows.ttft_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.ttft_p50_ms AS p50, windows.ttft_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Time per output token: p50 and p99 per time window (ms per token)
panels.description: Requests grouped by arrival time into windows (10 s of run time for sweeps).

targets.queryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.tpot_p50_ms AS p50, windows.tpot_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.tpot_p50_ms AS p50, windows.tpot_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Every request: time to first token, by arrival time (log scale)
panels.description: One dot per request, placed at its scheduled arrival time.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, ttft_ms AS value, label FROM requests JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE requests.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND success ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, ttft_ms AS value, label FROM requests JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE requests.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND success ORDER BY time

panels.title: Every request: end-to-end latency, by arrival time (log scale)
panels.description: One dot per request, placed at its scheduled arrival time.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, e2e_ms AS value, label FROM requests JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE requests.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND success ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, e2e_ms AS value, label FROM requests JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE requests.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND success ORDER BY time

panels.title: End-to-end latency: p50 and p99 per time window (log scale)
panels.description: Requests grouped by arrival time into windows (10 s of run time for sweeps).

targets.queryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.e2e_p50_ms AS p50, windows.e2e_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.e2e_p50_ms AS p50, windows.e2e_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Normalized latency: p50 and p99 per time window (ms per output token, log scale)
panels.description: e2e ÷ output tokens, requests grouped by arrival time.

targets.queryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.norm_latency_p50_ms AS p50, windows.norm_latency_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT windows.time, windows.norm_latency_p50_ms AS p50, windows.norm_latency_p99_ms AS p99, label FROM windows JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE windows.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate, per 1 s sample (%)
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens looked up in each sample that were already cached. Only samples with lookups are shown. Resumed needs our vLLM fork's counters.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, prefix_hit_rate AS [new requests], resume_hit_rate AS [resumed after preemption], label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, prefix_hit_rate AS [new requests], resume_hit_rate AS [resumed after preemption], label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Preemptions per 1 s sample
panels.description: Requests evicted for lack of KV blocks in each sample; compare with KV cache used.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, preemptions AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, preemptions AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: P/D: KV transfers per 1 s sample
panels.description: Disaggregated prefill/decode only: requests whose KV the decode GPU pulled over NIXL.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, kv_xfers AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, kv_xfers AS value, label FROM server JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE server.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time

targets.queryText:
SELECT label AS run, scenario, rate AS [rate (req/s)], rep AS repeat,
  offered_rps AS [offered (req/s)], steady_requests_per_s AS [completed (req/s)],
  steady_output_tokens_per_s AS [output (tokens/s)],
  ttft_mean_ms AS [TTFT mean (ms)],
  ttft_p50_ms AS [TTFT p50 (ms)],
  ttft_p90_ms AS [TTFT p90 (ms)],
  ttft_p95_ms AS [TTFT p95 (ms)],
  ttft_p99_ms AS [TTFT p99 (ms)],
  tpot_mean_ms AS [TPOT mean (ms/token)],
  tpot_p50_ms AS [TPOT p50 (ms/token)],
  tpot_p90_ms AS [TPOT p90 (ms/token)],
  tpot_p95_ms AS [TPOT p95 (ms/token)],
  tpot_p99_ms AS [TPOT p99 (ms/token)],
  itl_mean_ms AS [ITL mean (ms)],
  itl_p50_ms AS [ITL p50 (ms)],
  itl_p90_ms AS [ITL p90 (ms)],
  itl_p95_ms AS [ITL p95 (ms)],
  itl_p99_ms AS [ITL p99 (ms)],
  e2e_mean_ms AS [E2E mean (ms)],
  e2e_p50_ms AS [E2E p50 (ms)],
  e2e_p90_ms AS [E2E p90 (ms)],
  e2e_p95_ms AS [E2E p95 (ms)],
  e2e_p99_ms AS [E2E p99 (ms)],
  norm_latency_mean_ms AS [norm. latency mean (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p50_ms AS [norm. latency p50 (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p90_ms AS [norm. latency p90 (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p95_ms AS [norm. latency p95 (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p99_ms AS [norm. latency p99 (ms/token)],
  srv_running_mean AS [batch: mean running (requests)], srv_waiting_mean AS [queue: mean waiting (requests)],
  srv_waiting_max AS [queue: max waiting (requests)],
  srv_kv_cache_usage_mean * 100 AS [KV cache used, mean (%)], srv_kv_cache_usage_max * 100 AS [KV cache used, max (%)],
  srv_preemptions AS [preemptions (count)], srv_queue_mean_ms AS [vLLM queue wait, mean (ms)],
  [srv_queue_frac_over_1.0s] * 100 AS [waited > 1 s in vLLM queue (%)],
  srv_prefix_cache_hit_rate * 100 AS [prefix cache hit rate (%)],
  srv_resume_cache_hit_rate * 100 AS [resumed after preemption: KV still cached (%)],
  srv_kv_xfer_mean_ms AS [P/D KV transfer, mean (ms)], srv_kv_xfer_gb_per_s AS [P/D KV transfer (GB/s)],
  successes AS [completed (requests)], requests AS [sent (requests)], client_max_lag_ms AS [client max lag (ms)],
  run_id, experiment, from_ms, to_ms
FROM runs WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) ORDER BY mode, scenario, rate, rep
